newTopLevel.author: Sam O
newTopLevel.text:
@Liam Leung @Carlos Lopes

In a PR but that should be up today.

Some updates to the tables which need to be reflected on the FE

invoiceFields table
`billedBy`  - Choose the email we send from for this entity regarding invoice / automated emails

GET `/api/v1/invoices/entity/{entityId}/billing-profile` - now contains billedBy

Can be updated on these routes:
PUT `/api/v1/invoices/entity/{entityId}/billing-profile` — optional `invoiceFields.billedBy`
PATCH `/api/v1/invoices/entity/{entityId}/billed-by` — body `{ billedBy }` only

entities table
`isOnboarded`  - Is the entity onboarded, this verifies that we have the permission to send automated emails
`sendAutomatedEmails`  - This is allows us to send automated emails to entity (can be turned off) - will be set back to true once a billingcycle is complete, if isOnboarded is true

GET `/api/v1/invoiceFields/{entityId}/form`

Can be updated on this route:
PUT `/api/v1/invoiceFields/{invoiceFieldId}` — optional body `isOnboarded` + optional body `sendAutomatedEmails` → parent entity

sendAutomatedEmails (auto)
POST /api/v1/invoices/generate-required-invoices — after a successful draft create, sets sendAutomatedEmails = isOnboarded

GET `/api/v1/history/{id}/billing-cycles`
New data returned

                                "defaultCreditWeight": "4",

                                            "assetTypeId": 12,
                                            "assetTypeName": "Drafting Hours",
                                            "assetTypeQuantity": "0.8"

                                    }

New data to show case -
Want to display the studio name on left
then assetTypeName - similar to how task is currently done
then show quantity value underneath

PATCH `/api/v1/history/subtask-info-at-reset/:subTaskInfoAtResetId/assets`
This it to update the subtasks historical information -
Pass back the `assetTypeId`, `quantity`  and `creditWeight`
